scheme_name: ONGC Energy Centre (OEC) for Clean Energy Startups
overview: The ONGC Energy Centre (OEC) for Clean Energy Startups is an initiative by ONGC to support and nurture startups working in the clean energy sector. It provides a platform for innovation, mentorship, and collaboration to accelerate the development of sustainable energy solutions. The programme focuses on fostering entrepreneurship in areas such as renewable energy, energy efficiency, and emerging clean technologies. OEC aims to bridge the gap between research and commercialization by offering startups access to resources, expertise, and networking opportunities.
objectives: To support and nurture startups working in the clean energy sector
To provide mentorship and guidance to early-stage clean energy ventures
To facilitate access to ONGC’s resources, expertise, and infrastructure
To promote innovation in renewable energy, energy efficiency, and emerging clean technologies
To create a platform for collaboration between startups, industry, and research institutions
To accelerate the commercialization of clean energy solutions developed by startups
eligibility: Startups incorporated in India working on innovative solutions in the clean energy domain, including renewable energy, energy storage, energy efficiency, and related technologies, are eligible to apply. The startup must be registered under the Companies Act, 2013, or as an LLP or partnership firm, and should not be more than 5 years old at the time of application.
benefits: Selected startups receive mentorship from ONGC experts, access to OEC’s laboratory and testing facilities, opportunities for pilot projects and field trials, networking with industry stakeholders, and support in scaling their technologies. The programme also offers guidance on regulatory compliance, intellectual property, and funding avenues, along with visibility through OEC’s platforms and events.
financial_support: The ONGC Energy Centre does not provide direct financial grants or equity funding to startups. Support is primarily non-financial in nature, focusing on technical mentorship, infrastructure access, and collaborative opportunities. Any financial collaboration or investment would be explored separately based on mutual agreement and due diligence.
application_process: 1. Visit the ONGC Energy Centre website at https://ongcenergy.com 2. Navigate to the 'Startups' or 'Incubation' section 3. Fill out the online application form with details about the startup, technology, and team 4. Submit the application along with required documents 5. Await review by the OEC selection committee 6. Shortlisted startups may be invited for a presentation or interview 7. Final selection and onboarding into the incubation programme
required_documents: Detailed project report or business plan
Details of any existing funding or partnerships
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year.
implementing_agency: ONGC Energy Centre (OEC), Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC)
caveats: The programme does not guarantee funding or equity investment
Acceptance into the programme is subject to evaluation by the OEC selection committee
Startups must comply with ONGC’s confidentiality and intellectual property policies
OEC reserves the right to modify or terminate the programme at any time
Support is provided based on availability of resources and mutual agreement
